title: EXCLUSIVE: Haiwaan is 164 minutes long; CBFC replaces word with 'Kamina'; replaces 'derogatory' term with 'Girlfriend'
body: Here's the latest relationship update doing the rounds:

The Central Board of Movie Certification has passed Haiwaan with a U/A 16+ certificate. However, they asked for certain cuts. A visual in the beginning of the movie was 'suitably modified'. In the second half of the movie, a word was deleted and replaced with 'Kamina' . In the post-interval portion, a 'derogatory' word was deleted and replaced with 'Girlfriend'. Somewhere in the middle of the movie, a 'derogatory' sentence was deleted and replaced with 'Dimaag ki vaat laga ke rakh di' . Thankfully, no visual cuts were enforced. Hence, all the thrilling and action packed visuals have been left untouched by the Examining Committee of the CBFC.

Adding to this, Once these changes were made, the CBFC passed the movie today, that is, September 8. The length of the movie, as mentioned on the censor certificate, is 164.07 minutes. In other words, Haiwaan is 2 hours, 44 minutes and 7 seconds.

title: Bihar Congress row deepens as expelled leaders protest in Delhi, seek total revamp
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

A larger group of Congress leaders from Bihar, most of them expelled from the party after the debacle in the 2025 assembly polls, on Tuesday staged a dharna outside Indira Bhavan, the Congress headquarters in the national capital, to demand removal of the state unit chief Rajesh Kumar and the party in-charge Krishna Allavaru. They have also sought an appointment to meet Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi to appraise him of the issues of the party workers.

Adding to this, Senior Bihar Congress leader Anand Madhab, along with other Congress leaders and workers, stage a protest outside Indira Bhawan to seek a revamp in the state unit (ANI) Led by Anand Madhav, a former spokesperson of the Bihar unit of the Congress, the dharna was held from 11am to 4pm. HT reported on August 29 that a section of Bihar leaders would stage a dharna.
Meanwhile, Madhav shared they had to stage the protest because they were going unheard.

Notably, “A political party can be run on political vision and by political leaders, not by any agent. Current in charge and president does not have political vision, they are running party like a corporate that too in NGO format. Infact we feel that Krishna Allavaru and Rajesh Ram are working as they are above party constitution and party president. They are working on their whims and fancies. And making mockery of Bihar congress by coming out with weirded ideas,” he told HT.

As per the latest buzz, “We had to take this step because our issues remain unheard. We also want that the expulsion notices against us should be withdrawn and we should be reinstated in respectable positions in the BPCC,” Madhav shared, adding that they were seeking a meeting with senior party leader Rahul Gandhi also..

In further updates, Another expelled leader Shaukat Ali, former district president of Gopalganj, told reporters: “We want to meet [Rahul] Gandhi to tell him the actual situation of the party. We have four key demands that includes our meeting with Rahul Gandhi. Bihar Congress needs a revamp.”

On top of that, Senior Congress leader and AICC member Kishore Jha shared a disgruntled faction of state Congress workers has been consistently demanding that the party high command remove the state leadership and the state in-charge after the last assembly election results.

“They have also been making persistent efforts to meet the high command to offer key suggestions for the party’s improvement in the state; however, as their concerns were ignored, they were compelled to take such steps to press for their demands. To stage a dharna is an unfortunate decision but I urge the high command to engage with these individuals and take the necessary steps.”

title: SC directs Rajpal Yadav to deposit ₹5 crore for exemption from surrender in cheque bounce case
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

The Supreme Court on Tuesday directed star Rajpal Yadav to deposit ₹ 5 crore rupees with its Registry by Wednesday as a condition for exempting him from surrendering to serve his sentence in a cheque-bounce case involving movie producer-financier Murli Projects Pvt Ltd.

Adding to this, Rajpal Yadav was in Tihar Jail in relation to the cheque bounce case. Rajpal Yadav gets relief The Court issued a conditional notice on Rajpal Yadav’s plea challenging the Delhi High Court’s July 10 judgment upholding his conviction and three-month imprisonment in seven cases under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act. The matter will next be heard on September 15.

Meanwhile, A bench headed by the Chief Justice, Justice Joymalya Bagchi and Justice V. Mohana passed the order after his plea was orally mentioned. The Delhi High Court had required the star to surrender to serve the sentence, with September 10 being the deadline, after dismissing his criminal revisions against the conviction and sentence.

Notably, The case arises from seven complaints filed by Murli Projects against Yadav, his wife Radha Rajpal Yadav and their movie production company over dishonour of seven cheques issued in connection with financing for the movie Ata Pata Lapata.

As per the latest buzz, Back in 2010, Rajpal Yadav had borrowed ₹ 5 crore rupees from M/s Murali Projects Pvt Ltd for his directorial debut movie, Ata Pata Laapata. However, the movie turned out to be a ticket-window flop. Rajpal's failure to clear the dues, coupled with the accumulating interest, increased the outstanding amount to nearly ₹ 9 crore rupees. This eventually led to a prolonged legal battle.
In further updates, During a previous hearing, Yadav's counsel informed the court that approximately ₹ 4.25 crore rupees had already been paid to the complainant.

On top of that, In 2018, a magistrate court convicted Rajpal and his wife, Radha, in the case and sentenced him to six months in jail. In 2019, the sessions court upheld the conviction, following which Yadav approached the Delhi High Court in appeal. In June 2024, the High Court temporarily suspended his sentence and directed him to take “sincere and genuine measures" to repay the nearly ₹ 9 crore rupees dues.

In February, after failing to clear the dues, he surrendered and was sent to Tihar Jail. He was later granted interim bail on February 16 after depositing ₹ 1.5 crore rupees, following confirmation from the complainant’s lawyer. The relief was extended, with the Delhi High Court stating that he would not be taken back into custody even after the earlier interim order was set aside. The star also requested a 30-day extension to arrange the loan amount, but the Delhi High Court rejected his request and reserved its verdict.

title: Mirzapur The Movie box office collection day 5: Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal film maintains momentum, crosses ₹120 crore
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Mirzapur The Movie ticket-window earnings day 5 : Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal and Divyendu's gangster drama seems to be unstoppable. The movie, which opened to positive reviews from the critics, managed to cross the ₹ 100 crore rupees mark in just four days. Despite a slight dip in the Monday collection, the movie managed to hold well on Tuesday.

Adding to this, Mirzapur The Movie ticket-window earnings day 5: Ali Fazal reprises his role of Guddu Bhaiya in the movie. Mirzapur The Movie ticket-window report Mirzapur The Movie was expected to open well ever since its first teaser dropped earlier this year. But even the movie's supporters were surprised by its staggering performance in the heartland- particularly in UP, Bihar, and Delhi. Mirzapur defied all expectations and managed to collect ₹ 25.75 crore rupees. The collection even surpassed hits such as Saiyaara ( ₹ 22 crore rupees) and Awarapan 2 ( ₹ 21.50 crore rupees). Most trade experts estimated an opening of ₹ 18-20 crore rupees.

Meanwhile, Mirzapur The Movie registered a brilliant opening weekend, collecting ₹ 32 crore rupees on Saturday and ₹ 36 crore rupees on Sunday. On Monday, the movie expectedly dipped but still managed to mint in double numbers, collecting ₹ 16.24 crore rupees. On Tuesday, the movie has collected ₹ 15.85 crore rupees as per Sacnilk. The bulk of the earnings have come from the original Hindi version. The total India net now stands at ₹ 125.60 crore rupees .

Notably, The movie follows the fight for the Mirzapur throne as new contenders enter the battle. The movie brings back the lawless world of Mirzapur, where the battle for power continues amid a barrage of bullets, betrayals and bloody rivalries. The movie is set in 2018, hinting at an untold chapter from the first season of the show.

As per the latest buzz, Apart from Ali Fazal, Pankaj Tripathi and Divyenndu , the movie introduces Jitendra Kumar, who takes over from Vikrant Massey as Bablu Pandit. Ravi Kishan stars as a new face, while Abhishek Banerjee, Rasika Dugal, Sheeba Chadha, Rajesh Tailang, Shriya Pilgaonkar , Harshita Shekhar Gaur, and Shweta Tripathi reprise their roles from the show.

In further updates, Presented by Amazon MGM Studios and Excel Entertainment, Mirzapur: The Movie is directed by Gurmeet Singh, written by Puneet Krishna, and produced by Ritesh Sidhwani and Farhan Akhtar under the banner of Excel Entertainment. The movie is co-produced by Kassim Jagmagia and Vishal Ramchandani.

On top of that, Talking about taking the much-loved franchise from the OTT space to the big screen, Pankaj Tripathi told ANI, “The landscape is new, and the scale is bigger. People would have seen it on a 5-inch to a 100-inch screen. It was individual viewing. Now, it is coming for community viewing. Four hundred to five hundred people will see it together, and the screen is much bigger- 20 to 30 feet.”

title: Toxic OTT Rights: Streaming platforms in discussions, but deal figures are pure speculation
body: Here's the latest on what's streaming and coming up:

The development comes amid widespread reports suggesting that the value of Toxic ’s digital rights has taken a sharp hit following its theatrical performance. However, at this stage, there is no verified OTT deal or officially established figure, and several numbers doing the rounds in the industry should be treated as speculative.

Adding to this, The distinction is important, particularly because Toxic entered the market with considerable expectations. Directed by Geetu Mohandas and featuring Yash alongside Nayanthara, Kiara Advani, Tara Sutaria, Huma Qureshi and Rukmini Vasanth, the movie was mounted as a large-scale theatrical event. Its ticket-window trajectory, however, fell short of the expectations surrounding it.

Meanwhile, Recent reports have claimed that an earlier OTT offer was significantly higher than what platforms may currently be willing to pay. Some reports have even put the potential revised value at around Rs. 30 crores. However, Bollywood Hungama understands that no such figure should currently be presented as a concluded deal.

Notably, The streaming market has also become considerably more cautious in recent times, with platforms increasingly assessing theatrical performance, audience response and long-term streaming value before committing large sums to films.

As per the latest buzz, For Toxic , therefore, the OTT chapter remains a work in progress. While the theatrical run may have changed the commercial conversation around the movie, the eventual streaming deal will only become clear once negotiations conclude.

In further updates, An industry source familiar with the ongoing discussions tells Bollywood Hungama , "While Toxic may not have delivered the theatrical run that was expected, the movie continues to generate considerable curiosity, particularly around its digital premiere. Conversations with multiple platforms are currently underway, but no deal has been locked yet. Importantly, the figures being circulated in the market at this stage are purely speculative."

title: Chinmayi Sripaada questions Hindu group BAPS over Eiffel Tower row: ‘Women will pollute them or what?'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Singer Chinmayi Sripaada has reacted to reports that women employees at the Eiffel Tower in Paris were asked to leave during a Bochasanwasi Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Sanstha ( BAPS ) delegation’s visit. This as per reports led to the Eiffel Tower shutting down on Monday, with staff going on strike.

Adding to this, Chinmayi Sripaada reacts to BAPS Eiffel Tower row. What did Chinmayi Sripaada say? Chinmayi took to X (formerly Twitter) to share a news report and raised questions about BAPS' alleged request. She wrote, "Why should women stay out of sight when BAPS visit? Women will pollute them or what?"

Meanwhile, The Eiffel Tower staff alleged that female workers were asked to leave their work areas during a visit by the Bochasanwasi Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Sanstha (BAPS) group on Saturday, sparking a row. Following the incident, as per reports, staff at the French monument went on strike on Monday.

Notably, "During the visit of this delegation, women were asked to leave their places of work in order to place men there," staff union representative Diane Davoine told news agency Reuters. Davoine shared that the instruction left the women staff feeling "humiliated."

As per the latest buzz, "Tensions mounted over the weekend, so this morning, the employees decided to meet: first, to open a dialogue with management, and second, to ensure that women are never treated this way at the company again," she added.

In further updates, After the backlash, BAPS Hindu temple issued a statement on X and claimed that its visit was coordinated in advance with the teams at the Eiffel Tower during the opening hours of the monument.

On top of that, "To our knowledge, at no time was access to the Eiffel Tower denied to anyone. Nevertheless, we wish to offer our sincere apologies to anyone who may have been hurt or inconvenienced by this situation. We are deeply committed to the universal values of mutual respect and service to others," the statement read.

After the row, MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal responded to the reports. He shared, “We are aware of the opening of a temple by the BAPS Sanstha in the Paris area. As to the particular issue pertaining to the Tower, this is a matter purely between the entities concerned. It is a common practice for the Prime Minister to convey his good wishes on such occasions. In this case, it was done virtually. There is no cause for any comment in this regar

title: Mame Khan reacts to death of slain Manipuri musician he starred in music video with: ‘Shocking’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Rajasthan's celebrated playback and folk singer Mame Khan has reacted to the death of Manipuri musician and guitarist Chongtham Vikram Singh . Chongtham was allegedly beaten to death in Delhi after he objected to loud noises outside his flat on Sunday.

Adding to this, Mame Khan and Chongtham Vikram Singh had starred together in a music video. Mame Khan reacts to Chongtham Vikram Singh's death Mame Khan reshared singer Chinmayi Tripathi's Instagram story. Chinmayi had shared a poster calling people to gather and protest against Chongtham's death. She shared the same with the caption, "This is shocking you will always be remembered Vikram sir." Another caption read, "Really hope that the family gets justice." Mame Khan reshared her post.

Meanwhile, For the unversed, Mame Khan and Chongtham Vikram Singh had starred together in a music video in which they recreated the Rajasthani folk song Laal Peeli Ankhiyan. The video is described as Rajasthani folk music infused with flamenco and Western sounds. It shows Chongtham dressed in a colourful jacket and black pants as he plays the guitar, while Mame lends his unique voice to the folk song. The video dates back to 2018.

Notably, As per an earlier HT report, the musician was allegedly murdered after he raised an objection to commotion and noise outside his home at around 11.30pm on Sunday. On his trip downstairs to throw garbage, he saw a group of workers from two nearby dhabas shouting and creating a commotion, and intervened to stop them. “They chased him to the third floor, overpowered him in the corridor and rained blows on him before fleeing,” shared B Ruchida Sharma, a Manipuri social activist who works with people from the Northeast.

As per the latest buzz, Deputy commissioner of police (southeast) Vineet Kumar shared Sunlight Colony police station received a call about the assault at 1.38am on Monday. Chongtham Vikram Singh was taken to a private hospital in Okhla, where he died during treatment.

In further updates, Yaiphaba, the son of the musician, told PTI that the group of people was consuming alcohol and making noise outside their residence. “My father went downstairs and asked them not to make noise because we were being disturbed. They beat him up" He added that he found his father shirtless after he opened the door and accused them of thrashing him.
On top of that, He added, "Those people ran away. I took my father to the emergency room, where the doctor told us that his chances of survival were slim. Later, the doctor told us that he had died."

title: Tigmanshu Dhulia reveals how Shah Rukh Khan politely rejected him: ‘I don’t do realistic films’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Filmmaker Tigmanshu Dhulia is currently busy promoting his soon-to-release movie Ghamasaan, starring Pratik Gandhi and Arshad Warsi in the lead roles. During a recent interaction, Tigmanshu opened up that after completing the movie’s script, he had approached Shah Rukh Khan to play one of the lead roles. However, the star politely turned down the offer.

Adding to this, Bollywood star Shah Rukh Khan rejected Tigmanshu Dhulia. (File/AFP) How Shah Rukh Khan politely rejected Tigmanshu Dhulia's offer In conversation with Bollywood Hungama, Tigmanshu opened up that he had approached Shah Rukh Khan for the role of a police officer, which was eventually played by Pratik Gandhi. Recalling their conversation, he shared, “To tell the truth, when I wrote the script of this movie, I went to Shah Rukh Khan first for the role that Pratik Gandhi is playing in the movie. So he heard it and he is Shah Rukh Khan, his heart is like a football field. Also, we have known each other for a long time since Dil Se days and in the movie Zero, I played the role of his father. So he heard the script and he told me, ‘Yaar Tishu, mein is tarah ki realistic pictures nahi karta hoon yaar (I don't do realistic films like these).’”

Meanwhile, Arshad Warsi agreed with Shah Rukh's decision and added, “I get it. I also want to see him like a Tom Cruise. That's all. That poor guy, if he does anything realistic then I will have a problem.”

Notably, Tigmanshu has also been making headlines for his recent comments about Dhurandhar. The filmmaker dismissed the movie, saying that it has “no story”. In conversation with The Wire, he shared, “If someone asks you about the story of Dhurandhar, you can't tell it. There is a guy who goes to Pakistan aur vaha tabahi macha deta hai. Is this a story? The stories are finished in films. Also, those who tell the stories are also finished and those who want to tell stories aren't allowed to do so. They think that their films won't work. They follow the same pattern.”

As per the latest buzz, Linking capitalism to the lack of good storytelling in Bollywood, Tigmanshu shared, “This happens during extreme capitalism, people also start looking like each other. You see the fashion these days, everybody looks the same. They all have the same haircut. Even cities are looking identical to each other. The unique character of every city is finished. My city Allahabad (the name has been changed to Prayagraj) was known for so many different things but now it looks like any other city, same malls, same cars. This type of political system finishes your individuality.”

In further updates, Ghamasaan is described as a cat-and-mouse tale set in the Hindi heartland, where male friendships and rivalries unveil homoerotic tensions. Men on both sides of the law traverse arid lands, creating a strong sense of place where unexplored histories reside.
On top of that, The movie stars Pratik Gandhi and Arshad Warsi and will premiere on ZEE5 on September 11.

title: Tigmanshu Dhulia says Dhurandhar’s plot is “not a story,” blames “extreme capitalism” for film templates
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Tigmanshu Dhulia has criticised Dhurandhar’s plot and questioned the movie industry’s dependence on templates, calling it a result of ‘extreme capitalism’.

Adding to this, Without commenting on the movie's box-office performance, Dhulia questioned whether the basic premise of Dhurandhar qualifies as a story. The Ranveer Singh-led action thriller revolves around an undercover spy who travels to Pakistan and takes on its networks.

Meanwhile, “But if you ask about his story, you won't be able to tell the story of Dhurandhar . There is a man who is an undercover spy, he goes to Pakistan and creates a ruckus there. This is not a story,” Dhulia shared.

Notably, Dhulia went on to discuss what he believes is a larger problem with contemporary filmmaking. According to him, filmmakers and storytellers are increasingly restricted by assumptions about what audiences will accept commercially. “Stories are over in films. First of all, the storytellers are over and what they want to say is not allowed to be made. That story is not allowed to be told,” he shared.

As per the latest buzz, He added that concerns over whether a particular movie will work can influence the kind of stories that eventually reach audiences. “They feel that this movie will not work. There is only one kind of template. This is what happens when there is extreme capitalism,” Dhulia shared.

In further updates, He also extended his argument beyond cinema, suggesting that commercialisation has resulted in a growing sense of sameness in everyday life, including fashion and the identity of cities. “People also start looking the same. You go to a boy's fashion. Everybody looks the same. Same haircut. Every city looks the same. The character of every city is over,” he shared.

On top of that, Dhulia is currently promoting his soon-to-release directorial Ghamasaan , which is set to rollout directly on ZEE5 on September 11. The movie stars Pratik Gandhi and Arshad Warsi and is set against the rugged terrain of Bundelkhand.

Ghamasaan follows Maharaj, a feared dacoit leader played by Warsi, and Aditya, an STF officer portrayed by Gandhi, who is tasked with capturing him. As the officer moves deeper into Maharaj's territory, the operation as per reports uncovers political corruption that makes the mission more complicated than a straightforward manhunt.

title: Noida student who took part in CJP protest gets show-cause notice, revoked the same day
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

A student of Greater Noida's Gautam Buddha University (GBU) was served a notice by the district administration last week on Friday, seeking a personal bond of ₹ 5 lakh to ensure that he will maintain peace after he allegedly attended the student protest at Jantar Mantar . The notice was revoked the same day.

Adding to this, Police alleged that Akshat Tripathi's activities caused a tense atmosphere on the Gautam Buddha University campus. (File/HT Photo) The notice was issued by the Greater Noida Executive Magistrate on September 4 under Section 130 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), after proceedings were initiated under Sections 126 and 135 before the Assistant Commissioner of Police’s court, reported news agency PTI.

Meanwhile, The report submitted by the police , it was alleged that the student, Akshat Tripathi, encouraged other students of the university to participate in a protest called by a political party and that he was propagating anti-government narratives.

Notably, As per the notice, Tripathi was asked to show cause why he should not be directed to maintain peace for six months by furnishing a personal bond of ₹ 5 lakh, along with two sureties of the same amount and was due to appear for a hearing on September 5.

As per the latest buzz, The police also alleged that Tripathi's activities caused a tense atmosphere on the university campus which could have led to disruption of law and order. However, the police later clarified that the notice was revoked the same day.

In further updates, Tripathi denied the allegations made in the report and maintained that he participated in the protest peacefully and was not attending college at the time. He is originally from Prayagraj and currently lives in Greater Noida's Ecotech-1 area.
On top of that, He also alleged that he was injured in police action during the Parliament protest march on July 20.
The move by authorities was criticised by the Students' Federation of India (SFI), which called the action “repressive”.

title: Sonu Sood speaks out on Delhi building collapse, calls for affordable hostels for students on campus
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Sonu Sood has expressed solidarity with students after a building collapsed in Delhi's Satya Niketan , near Delhi University's South Campus, as per reports claiming the lives of seven students. Following the tragic incident, Sonu urged the government to build hostels for students and ensure access to safe living spaces.

Adding to this, Sonu Sood has spoken out on the Satya Niketan tragedy, that has claimed the lives of 7 students. 'Just 1 in 31 gets a hostel' Sonu took to his X account and wrote, “Every year, lakhs of students leave their homes to chase a dream in another city. But are we giving them a safe place to live? In Delhi, around 7 lakh students are enrolled, while hostel capacity is barely 30,000 — just 1 in 31 gets a hostel. Why not identify vacant government land around universities and allow/build safe, affordable student hostels there? Universities could also be given additional building permissions to create more on-campus accommodation."

Meanwhile, He added, “Students get safety. Parents get peace of mind. Universities and governments generate revenue. And, most importantly, we protect lives. Sometimes, a small change in policy can protect someone’s biggest dreams."

Notably, The absence of affordable on-campus housing at colleges under Delhi University are one of the biggest reasons why Paying Guest (PG) accomodations have seen a boom in the capital. While there are hostels available at some colleges, they are unable to meet the demand, hence pushing students from across India into private accommodation.

As per the latest buzz, Meanwhile, the Patiala House Courts has sent Satya Niketan building owner Hariram Gupta and his wife Urmila Gupta to 14 days of judicial custody, while their son Mahesh Gupta has been remanded to two days of police custody.

In further updates, Delhi chief minister Rekha Gupta visited the collapse site. A lookout circular (LOC) had been opened against building owner Hariram Gupta and his family members, a senior police officer told HT. He has now been apprehended.
On top of that, Rescue teams are continuing search operations at the site for the second straight day on Monday. Police personnel and a dog squad have been deployed at the site.
The building, located near Delhi University’s South Campus and opposite Sri Venkateswara College, collapsed at around 1:30 pm on Sunday while repair work was as per reports underway in the basement.

title: Preity Zinta watches Hanuman Ansh, urges fans to catch Vishal Chaturvedi’s film in theatres
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Vishal Chaturvedi's directorial Hanuman Ansh rolled out in theatres quietly but has now become one of the most talked-about films of the year. As the movie's ticket-window earnings keeps soaring, the movie is also finding support from Bollywood celebrities. After Varun Dhawan and Aditya Dhar, Preity Zinta has taken to Instagram to laud the movie.

Adding to this, Preity Zinta lauds Hanuman Ansh. Preity cheers for Hanuman Ansh On Instagram Stories, Preity shared photos of herself watching the movie in theatres. She captioned one of the photos with "Sita Ram" and "Wow". In another photo that she shared from the theatre, she urged her followers and followers not to miss the movie in theatres. She wrote, "Don't miss it folks."
Meanwhile, Before Preity, Dhurandhar director Aditya Dhar had also taken to Instagram to laud the movie. He had shared Hanuman Ansh's post and tagged the movie's director, Vishal Chaturvedi.

Notably, Bollywood A-lister Varun Dhawan was very vocal in his support for the movie. He posted on Instagram to share that he watched the movie with his mother. He had also encouraged his followers to watch the movie. He shared, "Please go to the theatre and watch Hanuman Ansh. I just went with my mom, and it was an amazing experience. Take your parents, go with your friends. I highly recommend this movie to everyone. No one had told me to make this video, neither had anyone called me; I just wanted to do this. I have had a connection with Lord Hanuman since childhood, but this is something else. This is a purely made movie. I will not even call it a movie; it’s something divine. You go and experience it."

As per the latest buzz, The star also lauded the movie's lead star and its direction. He wrote, "Shobhinaw Satyaa ji is brilliant in the movie. What a performance. And Visha ji, the direction you did, hats off. Brilliant stuff. Please everyone go and watch the movie."

In further updates, Hanuman Ansh is based on the life of spiritual leader Neem Karoli Baba. While many Bollywood celebrities are praising the movie, Vishal, in a recent podcast with Raunac, shared that many industry folks didn't help him during the making of the movie. He had shared, "After the movie started to do well, several people called me to congratulate me. I don’t want to name them. One of those who congratulated me was Madhur Bhandarkar, whom I had not asked for any support. However, I am not mentioning the others because I had sought help from those people, and they didn’t help me. Hence, I don’t want to name them for now, just because they are congratulating me."
On top of that, As per Sacnilk, Hanuman Ansh's India net collection stands at ₹ 132.13 Cr within 32 days of rollout.

title: ‘Dhurandhar has no story’: Tigmanshu Dhulia rejects Ranveer Singh films' ₹3,000 cr success; internet says ‘sour grapes'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar duology is among the most successful movie franchises Bollywood has ever seen, but filmmaker Tigmanshu Dhulia has a contrasting opinion on the films and their success. During a recent event, the filmmaker declared that Dhurandhar had 'no story' and also linked capitalism to the death of storytelling in the Hindi movie industry.

Adding to this, Tigmanshu Dhulia criticised Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar. 'Dhurandhar has no story' Tigmanshu was speaking at an event organised by The Wire. He was speaking on the subject, ‘The State of Media and Movie Industry.’

Meanwhile, Criticising Dhurandhar, Tigmanshu shared, “If someone asks you about the story of Dhurandhar, you can't tell it. There is a guy who goes to Pakistan aur vaha tabahi macha deta hai. Is this a story? The stories are finished in films. Also, those who tell the stories are also finished and those who want to tell stories aren't allowed to do so. They think that their films won't work. They follow the same pattern.”

Notably, Linking capitalism to the lack of good storytelling in Bollywood, he shared, "This happens during extreme capitalism, people also start looking like each other. You see the fashion these days, everybody looks the same. They all have the same haircut. Even cities are looking identical to each other. The unique character of every city is finished. My city Allahabad, (named has been changed to Prayagraj) was known for so many different things but now it looks like any other city, same malls, same cars. This type of political system finishes your individuality."

As per the latest buzz, Many didn't agree with the filmmaker. A comment on X read, "Another bitter, self-proclaimed “taste” merchant has crawled out of his cocoon." One more comment read, "If Peak Jealousy Had a FACE 😈 ." Another comment read, "Sour grapes."

In further updates, Tigmanshu is known for delivering critically acclaimed films. He is particularly known for his collaborations with late star Irrfan, including projects like Haasil and Paan Singh Tomar. He is currently gearing up for the rollout of his ZEE5 Original movie Ghamasan. The movie stars Arshad Warsi and Pratik Gandhi and is set to premiere on ZEE5 on September 11.

On top of that, Both Dhurandhar films were written and directed by Aditya Dhar. The films featured an ensemble cast consisting of Ranveer Singh, Akshaye Khanna, Sanjay Dutt, Arjun Rampal, R. Madhavan, Sara Arjun, Rakesh Bedi, Gaurav Gera and Danish Pandor, alongside several supporting actors. The movie follows the story of an undercover Indian intelligence agent played by Ranveer Singh, who infiltrates Karachi's criminal syndicates and political power structures in Pakistan in an effort to dismantle a terror network targeting India.
Together, both Dhurandhar films have minted over ₹ 3,000 crore rupees at the ticket-window.

title: Debuted with Kajol, a rival to three Khans; this Bollywood star saw his father murder whole family, 'vanished' for years
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The early 1990s saw a boom in Bollywood with many young actors starting their careers or finding their feet. As the older stars gave way to this younger lot, the three Khans became the frontrunners in no time. But for a while, they had competition in Rahul Roy, Ajay Devgn, Akshay Kumar, and Suniel Shetty, to name a few. Among them was one star, who battled a personal tragedy just to get where he was.

Adding to this, Star Kamal Sadanah was a bright young prospect in Bollywood in the early 90s. The star who saw his family murdered Kamal Sadanah debuted in Bollywood in 1992, the same year that Shah Rukh Khan and Akshay Kumar began their journey. Kamal’s debut movie, Bekhudi, also marked a 17-year-old Kajol’s debut. The movie was not a success, but he later found success with Rang. The 1993 rollout, also starring Divya Bharti, established Kamal as a bankable star. With his boyish looks, the 21-year-old was considered a rival to the three Khans as a viable romantic lead. One may assume that Kamal found success easily. But his path to this ‘overnight’ stardom was a tough one.

Meanwhile, In 1990, on the day Kamal was celebrating his 20th birthday, tragedy befell his household. As Kamal was busy preparing for his birthday party, his father, producer Brij Sadanah, shot and killed his wife and daughter (Kamal’s mother and sister). He shot at Kamal and then turned the gun on himself. Kamal was shot in the neck but survived.

Notably, In 2023, he recalled the night in an interview with Siddharth Kanan. “ "It is traumatic. To see your family being killed in front of your eyes. I was also shot. I had a bullet go from one side of my neck and come out from the other side. I have survived that. There is no logical reason for me to survive. It's almost as (if) the bullet dodged every nerve and came out from the other side. And I survived without any problems. No physical problems,” he shared.

As per the latest buzz, After Rang, Kamal signed a string of films, but all of them failed at the ticket-window. In 2005, he directed Karkash, a vehicle aimed to relaunch his career. But the movie tanked, too. The following year, he remade his father’s movie, Victoria No 203. But that too did not work at the ticket-window. And Kamal ‘vanished’ from Bollywood.

In further updates, He told HT in 2021 that he spent his time away upgrading his skills and learning new filmmaking craft. “At that time, I got back into production. I made independent films and directed and edited them. I did a course about visual effects, which I had to use while filming Roar: Tigers of the Sundarbans (2014). That was also amazing. Then I also did a course in animation, following which I started a small studio, which specialised in pre-visualisations.”

On top of that, In 2022, after being away from acting for close to two decades, Kamal returned to the big screen with a supporting role in Revathi’s Salaam Venky, reuniting with her first co-star Kajol. The following year, he had a minor role in Pippa, where he played Field Marshall Sam Manekshaw.

title: 72nd National Film Awards to be held in Gujarat; President Droupadi Murmu to present honours on September 22
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The venue shift marks a departure from a long-standing tradition. The first National Awards were presented in 1954 at Vigyan Bhawan in Delhi, which has hosted the ceremony on several occasions over the years. This year, the awards will instead be presented in Ekta Nagar, formerly known as Kevadia.

Adding to this, Ekta Nagar is home to the Statue of Unity, the world's tallest statue dedicated to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. Standing 597 feet tall, the monument was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in 2018.

Meanwhile, The winners of the 72nd National Movie Awards were revealed in July, with Article 370 emerging as the Best Feature Movie. The movie's lead star Yami Gautam was also named Best Star for her performance.

Notably, Malayalam superstar Mammootty and Bollywood star Kartik Aaryan will share the Best Star honour. Mammootty has been recognised for his performance in Bramayugam , while Aaryan won for his role in Chandu Champion .

As per the latest buzz, Star-filmmaker Randeep Hooda has also collected recognition at this year's awards. He has been named the Best Debut Director for Swatantrya Veer Savarkar , his directorial debut based on the life of Vinayak Damodar Savarkar.

In further updates, Meanwhile, Tamil movie Captain Miller , directed by Arun Matheswaran and starring Dhanush, has been named the Best Feature Movie Promoting National, Social and Environmental Values.

On top of that, The ceremony on September 22 is expected to bring together several of the year's biggest winners as the National Movie Awards begin a new chapter by moving the prestigious event outside Delhi for the first time.

title: Rajesh Sharma DENIES insect bite during Fauzi shoot; says, “Nothing happened on Prabhas’s film set”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Rajesh Sharma clarifies his hospitalisation, denies an insect bite on Fauzi's set and says a long-standing leg problem led to the infection.

Adding to this, Sharma was admitted to a hospital in Kolkata in July following reports of a serious leg infection and high fever. Around the time, director Sudipa Chatterjee, who is a close friend of the star, had put up a post claiming that Sharma may have been bitten by a suspected poisonous insect or spider while shooting for Fauzi in Hyderabad. The post was later deleted.

Meanwhile, In conversation with NDTV, Sharma clarified that the reports about an incident on the Fauzi set were incorrect. He also shared that his treatment has now been completed and that he is currently recovering.

Notably, “It's false news. Nothing happened on Prabhas's movie set. Neither Prabhas nor the unit was responsible in any way. They are nice people. Nothing happened in Hyderabad while I was shooting there,” Sharma shared.

As per the latest buzz, The star claimed that he had been dealing with a skin problem on his right leg for a long time. According to Sharma, the condition eventually developed into an infection. He added that the situation became more serious after he returned to Kolkata, particularly because his diabetes levels were very high.
In further updates, Sharma admitted that he did not initially take the problem seriously, which contributed to the situation becoming severe.

On top of that, Addressing Sudipa Chatterjee's earlier post, Sharma shared that she had shared it out of concern but did not have the correct information. “She's a good friend. Out of concern, she posted that. But she was wrong informed,” he shared.
Sharma has now completed his treatment and shared that his recovery is underway. The star is hopeful of returning to work soon and opened up that he may resume shooting within a week.

title: Neena Gupta says older actors have more ego, insecurity; recalls when a star pulled her out of the frame | Interview
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Neena Gupta has been a part of the entertainment industry for over four decades. In a career that has seen her appear in some of the biggest Bollywood films, TV shows, and international productions, she has worked with a wide range of performers and personalities. But the 67-year-old says she feels most at home with the younger actors, a generation junior to her. The reason, she tells Hindustan Times in a chat, is the ‘ego and insecurities’ that actors of her generation have.

Adding to this, Neena Gupta talks about the most 'exhausting' generation of actors. Neena Gupta on the ‘ego’ in older actors Neena Gupta began her career with small parts in films such as Gandhi and Mandi in the early 80s, before making a name for herself in Indian parallel cinema. The last decade has seen her extensively in mainstream Bollywood films and web series such as Panchayat and Masaba Masaba. The star is currently promoting her soon-to-release show, Chumbak . Ahead of its rollout, she sat down with Hindustan Times for a chat with her co-stars. We noted that she has worked with almost 4-5 generations of actors and asked if there is one she finds the most ‘exhausting’. True to her outspoken self, the veteran star replied promptly, “The older generation!”

Meanwhile, Neena added that she prefers working with the younger actors. “I get along so well with this younger generation. Lagta hi nahi ki main inse bahut badi hoon (I don’t feel like I am much older than them). When I work with (actors of) my generation, bahut taqleef hoti hai (it is very difficult).”
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Amyra Dastur (@amyradastur)

As per the latest buzz, The veteran star says she found that actors of her generation were riddled with insecurities. Recalling an incident, she tells us, “They have so much ego. Once during a shoot, this star was standing behind me, and he thought he wasn’t visible (in the frame). So he pulled me back and took my spot. This is how it is. They have ego problems and insecurities.”

In further updates, In Chumbak, most of her co-stars are more than 20 years younger than her. Talking about how contrasting it is to work with them, Neena says, “Also, unko koi bhi baat lag jaati hai (they take offence to anything). They take it very personally. With these people (her co-stars in Chumbak), I can say anything to them, and they don’t mind. So I always prefer working with younger actors.”

On top of that, In Chumbak, Neena stars alongside a large ensemble cast including Deven Bhojani, Sandeepa Dhar, Sumeet Vyas, Manasi Joshi, Amyra Dastur, Sumeet Raghavan, Helly Shah, Arjun Bijlani, and Delnaaz Irani. Written and directed by Aatish Kapadia and produced by JD Majethia, the show will stream on Netflix from September 11.

title: Nora Fatehi sued for Rs 3 crores by aviation company over alleged “toy” and “Lego airplane” comments: Report
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

According to a PTI report, Dunes Aviation has accused Nora of making “derogatory and reckless” remarks after she shared videos from inside the company’s aircraft during a Mumbai-Jaipur flight in December last year. The company has alleged that the star referred to the aircraft as a “miniature”, a “toy” and a “Lego airplane” in the videos posted on her Instagram account.
Adding to this, The matter is as per reports scheduled to come up before senior civil judge R Agarwal on September 25.

Meanwhile, In its suit, Dunes Aviation has as per reports claimed that Nora’s remarks reached a substantial audience because of her social media following, which the company puts at more than 4.6 crores followers.

Notably, The aviation firm has alleged that the posts caused reputational and commercial damage, including booking cancellations and a decline in business. According to the company, its bookings dropped by 15 to 20 per cent following the row, while cancellations increased.

As per the latest buzz, Dunes Aviation has described Nora’s alleged comments as “reckless, irresponsible, and made without any technical knowledge, verification or factual basis”. The company has further claimed that the remarks resulted in “serious reputational damage, loss of goodwill and adverse commercial impact”.

In further updates, Dunes Aviation has also addressed the comments about the aircraft itself. According to the suit, the Cessna Citation CJ2 used for the Mumbai-Jaipur journey was a standard aircraft and appropriately sized for the flight.
On top of that, The company has shared that the aircraft was fully DGCA-certified and airworthy and was being operated legally under a valid Non-Scheduled Operator’s Permit (NSOP).

Apart from Rs 3 crores in damages, Dunes Aviation has as per reports asked the court to direct Nora to remove social media posts and other online content containing the alleged remarks or references to the aircraft.

title: India's most successful star kid gave ' ₹2000 cr film' at 27, was lauded at Cannes; not Ranbir Kapoor, Salman, Allu Arjun
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The term ‘nepo baby’ may be a modern Hollywood invention, but back home, India has used ‘ star kids ’ for the same group - children or relatives of people from the industry who have had a foot in the door. Many of these star kids have gone on to have successful careers, most before the term ‘nepotism’ was a buzzword on Reddit and Twitter. Examples of successful star kids exist in every language and across industries, but one of them surpassed even his illustrious father, and very early in his career.

Adding to this, This unassuming pre-teen would direct all-time blockbusters by 25. India’s most successful star kid In the 1920s, Prithviraj Kapoor began his career as an star, working in plays in Lahore. In 1928, as he moved to Bombay, he moved into cinema acting. By the 30s, Prithviraj was considered one of the leading actors in Hindustani cinema. His younger brother, Trilok Kapoor, joined him in the profession with Char Dervesh in 1933, thus establishing the Kapoor family , a clan that continues to produce Bollywood actors even today. The first ‘star kid’ from the family entered films when Prithviraj’s eldest son, Raj Kapoor , appeared in the 1935 movie Inquilab as a child star. But he had to wait till 1946 to make his debut as a leading star. Success came to him with Neel Kamal in 1947.

Meanwhile, But it was his work in 1949 that shot him to stardom. All of 25, Raj Kapoor gave back-to-back hits in Andaz and Barsaat. The latter became the highest-grossing Indian movie at the time, breaking Kismet’s record with a ₹ 2-crore rupees haul. This helped Raj Kapoor establish himself as one of the three leading men in Bollywood, alongside Dilip Kumar and Dev Anand. The three would rule Hindi cinema in the 1950s and 60s.

Notably, If Barsaat’s success was astonishing, Raj Kapoor had more in store. In 1951, he starred in and directed Awara, a movie with socialist and reformist themes. At 27, it was his third movie as a director, and arguably most successful as well. Awara was an all-time smash hit, running to packed houses in both India and the Soviet Union. It collected over ₹ 15 crore rupees worldwide. If adjusted for inflation, that would amount to a gross of ₹ 2000 crore rupees today, making Awara one of Hindi cinema’s most successful films to date. The movie’s success helped Raj Kapoor establish himself as a big star in Russia. All his subsequent films were hits there.

As per the latest buzz, Over the course of his career, Raj Kapoor collected critical acclaim alongside commercial success. Awara competed for the top prize at the Cannes Movie Festival. Four years later, Boot Polish was also feted at the festival and vied for the Palme d'Or. Jagte Raho (1956) won the Crystal Globe award at the Karlovy Vary International Movie Festival.

In further updates, Over the years, several star kids have gone on to have successful careers, including Raj’s own son, Rishi Kapoor ; brothers Shashi and Shammi Kapoor; and grandson Ranbir Kapoor. Salman Khan and Aamir Khan also come from movie families. Among women, Nutan and Kajol were the top stars in their eras. Outside Bollywood, Nagarjuna, Allu Arjun, Prabhas, Jr NTR, Nandamuri Balakrishna, Prithviraj Sukumaran, and Siva Rajkumar have all been at the top of their respective industries at some point or another. What sets Raj Kapoor apart is not just his success as an star but also his influence as a director-producer.

On top of that, As an star, he worked in 63 films, giving 17 hits, including 5 blockbusters and 2 all-time blockbusters. He remains the only star to star in two highest-grossing Indian films, back-to-back. His films like Awara and Jaagte Raho opened up a new market - Russia - for Indian cinema, and began the trend of focusing on overseas collections.

As a director, he had a near-perfect success rate, with 8 of his 10 directorials succeeding at the ticket-window. With Sangam, he became the first Indian filmmaker to shoot overseas. In Mera Naam Joker, he introduced the largest international cast for an Indian movie. He also introduced actors such as Nimmi, Rishi Kapoor, Dimple Kapadia, and Zeenat Aman to the industry. But perhaps his most telling contribution to Indian cinema is the marriage of social themes with smash hit films, which he did time and again, from Awara to Ram Teri Ganga Maili.

title: Aasif Khan once said Bigg Boss ‘isn't his thing’; old clip resurfaces after season 20 entry: ‘Off-camera acting nahi’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Hosted by Bollywood star Salman Khan , Bigg Boss 20 premiered on September 6. Panchayat star Aasif Khan , who played the role of the angry groom Ganesh on the show, was among the 16 celebrities who entered the Bigg Boss house. While Aasif's entry excited his followers, social media users dug up an old video of the star in which he shared he would never participate in Bigg Boss.

Adding to this, Aasif Khan is one of contestants on Bigg Boss 20. 'This isn’t my kind of thing' In a 2024 conversation with Hindi Rush, Aasif Khan was asked if he wanted to join Bigg Boss. The Panchayat star instantly replied, “Nahi. (No)." He also shared that he had been approached for the reality show in the past.

Meanwhile, He also spoke about watching the show and realising that it was not something he was interested in. He had shared in Hindi, "No. I had even received an offer last time. It came in 2022. Someone had asked me about it. So then I asked one or two of my close friends about it, because it had come my way. At one point, I don’t remember which season it was, but I watched it quite a lot. I watched it for about a month. This was many years ago. After a point, I realised that this isn’t my kind of thing."
Notably, He explained that he doesn't believe in ‘off-camera acting’ and shared that people shouldn’t be acting when the cameras are off, which is why he didn't feel Bigg Boss was his kind of show.

As per the latest buzz, He shared, “Main life mein bhi bahut saare logon ko, apne doston ko bolta hoon ki off-camera acting nahi karni chahiye. Toh off-camera acting se mujhe badi allergy hai uss cheez se. To isliye maine kaha ye apne taste ki cheez nahi hai. Chhod diya maine fir. (Even in life, I tell a lot of people, my friends, that you shouldn’t act off-camera. So I have a big allergy to that whole thing—off-camera acting. That’s why I shared this isn’t something that suits my taste. So I let it go)."

In further updates, Aasif is known for his character roles in films like Pagglait, Pari, The Great Indian Family and The Bhootnii. He has also been a part of celebrated web shows such as Mirzapur, Jamtara and Paatal Lok. He is known for playing the disgruntled groom in one episode of Panchayat Season 1 and later appeared in Panchayat Season 3.

title: PM's Economic Advisory Council member Sanjeev Sanyal says he loved Dhurandhar: ‘If you don’t like it, don't watch it'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Filmmaker Aditya Dhar’s Dhurandhar franchise created a stir at the ticket-window. The first part, rolled out in December 2025, collected over ₹ 1,300 crore rupees worldwide, while its sequel, Dhurandhar: The Revenge , went on to become the first Bollywood movie to cross the ₹ 1,000 crore rupees mark at the domestic ticket-window. These achievements came despite the franchise being labelled “propaganda” and facing criticism over its depiction of violence. Now, Sanjeev Sanyal , a member of the Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister, has opened up that he loved the franchise.

Adding to this, Sanjeev Sanyal reacts to Dhurandhar being labelled propaganda. Sanjeev Sanyal says he loved Dhurandhar In an interview with News18, Sanjeev shared that different kinds of films should have the space to tell stories and present different ideas. He shared, "I did watch those two Dhurandar films and I really loved them," Sanyal shared. “But you can tell that I didn’t really know many of the actors in that! I literally know who they are because of Dhurandhar."

Meanwhile, He further reacted to the movie being called propaganda and shared, "My view is, let a hundred flowers bloom. For example, people in the past would make films which I would consider being ultra-left-wing, which was the default till very of late; I was told that if you don’t like it, don’t watch it. So my view remains that that’s a pretty good way of thinking about it. If you don’t like Dhurandhar, don’t watch it. If you don’t like Revolutionaries, don’t watch it. My idea is to present my ideas."

Notably, Starring Ranveer Singh in the lead role, alongside Arjun Rampal, Rakesh Bedi, Sara Arjun, Akshaye Khanna and Sanjay Dutt, Dhurandhar and Dhurandhar: The Revenge were massive critical and commercial successes. The franchise has collected over ₹ 3,000 crore rupees worldwide.

As per the latest buzz, Sanjeev Sanyal is currently awaiting the rollout of the show The Revolutionaries, which is based on his book Revolutionaries: The Other Story Of How India Won Its Freedom. Helmed by Nikkhil Advani, the show explores the lives of young Indian freedom fighters who believed armed resistance was essential to ending British colonial rule. The show stars Bhuvan Bam, Rohit Saraf, Pratibha Ranta, Gurfateh Pirzada, Jason Shah and Pratik Motwani in key roles. It is scheduled to rollout on Prime Video on September 11.

In further updates, Talking about the show, Bhuvan shared at the trailer launch, "I want to say a few things. title: A second post-credits scene was shot for Mirzapur: The Movie, but was deleted from the film; here's why
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mirzapur : The Movie is wreaking havoc at the ticket-window. The spinoff of the popular web series has collected over ₹ 100 crore rupees net domestically and ₹ 150 crore rupees gross worldwide in just four days in theatres. What has excited followers is not just the return of their favourite characters, but a potential sequel, hinted at in a post-credits scene. Now, sources have shared that another post-credits scene was shot for the movie, but the makers decided to hold it back.

Adding to this, Mirzapur The Movie stars Ali Fazal in the lead role. Mirzapur The Movie’s deleted post-credits scene According to an independent industry source, “There was another end-credit scene that was shot for Mirzapur: The Movie, but the makers consciously decided to hold it back for Part 2. The scene initially was to feature at the end of the movie and set up what comes next, but the team felt its narrative significance would have a much bigger impact when the story continues.” There is no information about who the scene featured and what it revealed. Sources say the movie’s makers want to keep some reveals for the planned sequel. “The scene that was held back is now expected to feature as part of the next chapter of the movie,” the source adds.

Meanwhile, The existing end credits scene of Mirzapur: The Movie shows Guddu Pandit ( Ali Fazal ), Munna Tripathi ( Divyenndu ), and Bablu Pandit (Jitendra Kumar) sitting and chatting in a hair salon when Munna and Guddu learn they are in love with the same girl, Sweety (Shriya Pilgaonkar). The scene ends with both of them drawing guns on each other, hinting at a clash between the two in the sequel.
Notably, Sources say the plan for the sequel did not originate from the movie’s box-office success. Part 2 had always been on the cards, which is why the two end-credits scenes were shot.

As per the latest buzz, Mirzapur began streaming on Prime Video in 2019, becoming one of the most popular and watched Indian web series over three seasons. Mirzapur The Movie’s plot runs parallel to the first season, serving as an origin story for the clash between the Tripathis and the Pandit brothers. title: Rajesh Sharma reveals real reason behind hospitalisation on Prabhas' Fauzi set, dismisses earlier claims
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

In July this year, star Sudipa Chatterjee issued a press note revealing that star Rajesh Sharma had been hospitalised after as per reports suffering an insect bite on the set of Prabhas ’ soon-to-release movie Fauzi. However, in a recent interview with NDTV, Rajesh has now shared a health update and dismissed reports that an insect bite led to his hospitalisation.

Adding to this, Star Rajesh Sharma reveals diabetes led to severe infection. Rajesh Sharma reveals reason behind hospitalisation Rajesh revealed what actually happened and shared that he had been dealing with a skin problem in his right leg for a long time. His condition worsened as his diabetes levels were high, although he initially did not realise how serious the situation was. He added that his treatment is now over and that he is recovering, with hopes of returning to work within a week.

Meanwhile, Dismissing reports of an insect bite, he shared, "It's false news. Nothing happened on Prabhas's movie set. Neither Prabhas nor the unit was responsible in any way. They are nice people. Nothing happened in Hyderabad while I was shooting there. After I flew back to Kolkata, in a day or two, the situation became severe. Because my diabetes was very high and I didn't take it seriously at the beginning."

Notably, He further defended Sudipa and shared, "I have had a skin problem in my right leg for long. From there, I have got the infection. She's a good friend. Out of concern, she posted that. But she was wrong informed."

As per the latest buzz, Sudipa posted on Instagram and shared a statement on behalf of Rajesh’s family, which read, "Star Rajesh Sharma as per reports suffered an insect bite-possibly from a bug or a poisonous spider-while shooting at Ramoji Movie City for a movie starring renowned star Prabhas. After pack-up, Rajesh was chatting with local technicians in an area surrounded by dense vegetation when he felt an insect bite. As it did not seem serious at the time, he continued without seeking immediate medical attention.”

In further updates, "But six hours later, the star began experiencing severe pain in his right leg and felt unwell. “Despite his worsening condition, he boarded a flight back to Kolkata. During the journey, he developed a high fever, became increasingly restless, and his health deteriorated further. The following day, he was admitted to Manipal Hospital, Dhakuria. More than a day has passed since his hospitalisation but he suffers from high fever, breathlessness and a progressing infection in his right leg." the note further read.

On top of that, Prabhas is currently shooting for Hanu Raghavapudi’s Fauzi and Sandeep Reddy Vanga’s Spirit. Meanwhile, Rajesh is awaiting the rollout of his soon-to-release movie, Haiwaan. Helmed by Priyadarshan, the movie also stars Saif Ali Khan, Akshay Kumar and Saiyami Kher in key roles. It is scheduled to rollout in theatres on September 11.

title: ‘Can't accept Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama’: Ramanand Sagar's grandson Shiv Sagar says ‘fresh face’ was needed in Ramayana
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ever since he was revealed as Lord Rama in Nitesh Tiwari's soon-to-release Ramayana adaptation, Ranbir Kapoor has divided fan opinions. After the rollout of the teaser and first look, many viewers were convinced he was the right choice, but others remained sceptical. Now, Shiv Sagar, grandson of Ramanand Sagar, who made the most memorable adaptation of the epic, has shared that Ranbir will bring baggage from his past roles into the movie.

Adding to this, Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama in Ramayana Part 1. ‘Can't accept Ranbir Kapoor as Rama’ Shiv Sagar is the grandson of legendary filmmaker Ramanand Sagar, who famously made the 1987 Doordarshan show Ramayan, and its follow-up, Lav-Kush. Of late, Shiv expressed his displeasure with the casting of Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, particularly after Ranbir had played a violent man in Animal.

Meanwhile, “Except for that one casting, I like the rest of the casting very much. Personally, I cannot accept Ranbir Kapoor as Ram because after Animal, I cannot accept him as Ram. When I look at Ram ji, I feel that a fresh face should have been taken,” Shiv Sagar shared, as per ANI.

Notably, “We have seen Ranbir in different roles; he is a very good star. Personally, I don't have anything against him. I think they must have taken him for the project because they want a marketing push, and maybe if they didn't take Ranbir, the movie wouldn't have been marketed so well, so that's also something to think about, but I personally believe that for such characters, it's better to take a new face,” he elaborated.

As per the latest buzz, The director-producer lauded the rest of the cast, including Yash as Ravana and Sai Pallavi as Sita. “You can take a very strong supporting cast, like Yash is looking very good, Sai Pallavi is looking very good, they don't have that much baggage. He has a lot of baggage. That's why we usually take a new face in our serials, so they don't have any baggage or history,” shared Shiv Sagar. However, the filmmaker conceded that, in the end, his personal opinion will not matter if the audience accepts Ranbir in the role. He shared that ‘the public is the king’ and they will have the final word on the matter once the movie is rolled out.

In further updates, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra, the soon-to-release Ramayana is a two-part movie starring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Yash, Ravie Dubey, and Sunny Deol in lead roles. Arun Govil, who played Lord Rama in Ramanand Sagar's Ramayan, plays King Dashrath in this movie. Part One will rollout in theatres this November, with the concluding part slated to rollout in time for Diwali 2027.

title: Aashiqui star Rahul Roy reveals dancing at weddings for ₹2 lakh to earn after brain stroke: ‘Getting work was difficult’
body: Here's the latest relationship update doing the rounds:

Of late, Bollywood star Rahul Roy found himself back in the spotlight after videos of him dancing at weddings and performing to his old songs went widely shared on social media. Now, in an interview with the Times of India, Rahul opened up about his financial struggles and opened up that he has been performing at weddings and events to keep things going as he rebuilds his life after a brain stroke.

Adding to this, Rahul Roy opens up about financial struggles. Rahul Roy on building his life from scratch, facing financial struggles The star opened up that he has been fighting a ₹ 30 lakh legal case for years and that he and his brother are working to settle it. Rahul also opened up that a few years ago, he went through a divorce case during which he transferred his assets to his wife. He shared that he is now trying to rebuild his life and career and create his empire from scratch.

Meanwhile, Rahul added, "The last five years have almost been like a break because I was recuperating. There was no work. If that hadn’t happened, I would have done much more. But now, I am getting some work and want to do a lot more. I was happy to be back on the set and face the camera. I am really thankful to the people who are trusting me. In my 37-year journey in films, I believe I have done some good work, and now I am looking forward to doing more.”

Notably, Talking about his financial struggles, Rahul shared, "I have expenses, and I need the money. Getting work after my brain stroke in 2020 was difficult. It’s been five years since then, and I was doing whatever I could to keep things going. Sometimes, I earn ₹ 2 lakh or 4 lakh by dancing at weddings. People who troll me don’t know that this is hard work. I have to earn my bread and butter too.”

As per the latest buzz, In November 2020, Rahul suffered a cerebrovascular stroke while he was in Kargil for the shoot of LAC – Live The Battle. He was rushed to Srinagar for treatment and was subsequently shifted to Mumbai. The star was admitted to Nanavati Hospital, where he spent several days in the ICU.

In further updates, His journey in Bollywood began with Aashiqui in 1990, which saw him share the screen with Anu Aggarwal. The movie became a massive hit and changed Rahul’s career overnight, making him a popular face among Hindi movie audiences. After a spate of flops in the 90s, Rahul moved to television in the 2000s. In 2007, he participated in the first season of Bigg Boss and emerged as the winner, defeating Carol Gracias and receiving the ₹ 1 crore rupees prize.

On top of that, Rahul’s recent movie work includes Kanu Behl’s psychological drama Agra, which hit theatres in November 2025. He is also gearing up for his next project, Kuku TV’s Super Badshah. In the show, he will portray an underworld don, with Karanvir Bohra also in the cast.

title: Akshay Kumar recalls house help spilling 4 glasses of water on Amitabh Bachchan: ‘What will happen now?’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood legend Amitabh Bachchan rose to stardom after his 1973 movie Zanjeer broke ticket-window records and established him as a star. Over the decades, the star has amassed a massive fan following across generations and walks of life. The star still greets a sea of followers who wait for his glimpse outside his bungalow in Mumbai every Sunday. Of late, Akshay Kumar shared an anecdote that offered a glimpse into Amitabh's immense stardom.

Adding to this, Akshay Kumar shared a hilarious anecdote about Amitabh Bachchan on KBC. Akshay Kumar's house help spilled water on Amitabh Bachchan Akshay appeared on Kaun Banega Crorepati with Saif Ali Khan. The two stars were present on the show to promote their soon-to-release movie Haiwaan. During a segment of the show, Akshay recalled the time Amitabh Bachchan visited his house when he lived in Lokhandwala, Mumbai.

Meanwhile, Akshay opened up that one of the people who worked at his house was such a huge fan of Amitabh that he became overwhelmed upon seeing the superstar in person. In his excitement, he ended up spilling glasses of water on the star.

Notably, Addressing Amitabh, Akshay shared, “Sir, do you remember when you came to my house? I am talking about Lokhandwala, when I used to live there. The person who worked at my house had to give you some water. There were three or four glasses kept there. I remember it very clearly. Sir was wearing a kurta and that boy was from Allahabad. He looked at you and simply couldn't believe that he was actually giving Amitabh ji a glass of water."

As per the latest buzz, He added, "So, he came over with the water. There were four glasses, and he ended up spilling all four glasses on your kurta because he was so stunned that he couldn't even see properly. I was thinking, what will happen now? Sir is obviously very tall, so I had to give you my kurta so that it would fit you."
In further updates, The anecdote left Amitabh and those present laughing on the show.

On top of that, Haiwaan is a crime thriller movie co-written and directed by Priyadarshan. It is a remake of Priyadarshan's own 2016 Malayalam movie Oppam and stars Akshay Kumar, Saif Ali Khan, Boman Irani, Shriya Pilgaonkar and Saiyami Kher. Mohanlal also makes a cameo appearance in the movie. The movie also marks the final on-screen performance of late legendary star Asrani, who passed away in October 2025.
The movie stars Saif Ali Khan as a blind character, Vibijeet Khurana, while Akshay plays the negative role of Abhijeet.

title: 'Orwellian dystopia': Allahabad HC reprimands Noida DM over DU student's NSA detention during Noida workers protest
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:
Allahabad High Court came down heavily on Gautam Buddha Nagar District Magistrate Medha Roopam last week while quashing the detention of a Delhi University student and called her conduct “despotic”.

Adding to this, Akriti Chaudhary was detained under the stringent National Security Act (NSA) and the order of detention was passed by Noida DM Medha Roopam. (X/@MedhaRoopam) On Wednesday last week, the Allahabad high court quashed the detention order against a 25-year-old Delhi University graduate Akriti Chaudhary who has been in judicial custody for around five months in connection with the Noida workers’ protest of April 2026, saying her detention was based on a “concocted story”.
Meanwhile, Chaudhary was detained under the stringent National Security Act (NSA) and the order of detention was passed by Roopam.

Notably, While quashing the move, the bench of justice Atul Sreedharan and justice Achal Sachdev made a reference to English writer George Orwell, who is well-known for his dystopian novel ‘1984’ and his allegorical novella ‘Animal Farm’.
As per the latest buzz, The court shared that “it shan't be long before the errant in the bureaucracy reduce the State of Uttar Pradesh to an Orwellian Dystopia”, reported Live Law.
In further updates, It also shared that when bureaucrats and cops go against their oath, they may be viewed as an “oppressive vestige of the British Empire”.

On top of that, The bench also ordered immediate rollout of Chaudhary and awarded her a compensation of ₹ 5 lakh and directed that it must be recovered from the salaries of the district magistrate to every officer responsible “right down to the SHO”.

The court observed that the police report only contained allegations against Chaudhary and it was on the district magistrate to examine the record 'threadbare' and see if the case warranted stringent action such as the NSA.

body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Adding to this, Nora Fatehi has landed in row for her remarks. About the defamation suit The court of senior civil judge R Agarwal will hear the matter on September 25.

Notably, The company alleged that "reckless" statements made by the star, who has more than 4.6 crore rupees followers, triggered booking cancellations and severely hurt its commercial operations.

As per the latest buzz, The suit, filed in April this year, shared that Nora Fatehi's statements were "reckless, irresponsible, and made without any technical knowledge, verification or factual basis".

In further updates, Dunes Aviation shared that owing to Nora Fatehi's substantial follower base, her "reckless statements" have caused "serious reputational damage, loss of goodwill and adverse commercial impact" to the company.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The tour will eliminate VIP seating, ensuring every attendee enjoys an equal experience.

Adding to this, Bagchi’s definitive hits ‘ Aaj Ki Raat ’ ( Stree 2 ), ‘ Uyi Amma ’ ( Azaad ) and ‘ Shararat ’ and ‘ Ramba Ho ’ ( Dhurandhar ) became a bona fide global streaming phenomenon. Combining the rigorous vocal heritage of her Hindustani classical training under the Agra Gharana with a sharp, modern pop sensibility, Bagchi’s two-hour live setlist promises to be a masterclass in sonic contrast. Followers can expect heavy-hitting live renditions of her career-defining catalog, including the cinematic ‘ Nazariya Ki Maari ’ (Heeramandi), the high-octane Pan-Indian banger ‘ Peelings ’ ( Pushpa 2: The Rule - Hindi), her chart-topping pop collaborations, and the dance-floor staple ‘ Barbaadiyan ’ (Shiddat), alongside the intimate indie-pop streaming favorite ‘ Ishq Hai ’ (Mismatched).

Meanwhile, Built entirely on an ‘anti-widely shared’ strategy of artistic integrity, the tour honours the audience's time with a strict, 100% authentic ‘no lip-sync’ live guarantee backed by a massive orchestral band. It also carries deep personal significance as a three-generation family tribute, fulfilling her late grandfather's unreleased dream of seeing a professional musician rise from their lineage.

Notably, Madhubanti Bagchi shared, “Performing live is where music truly comes alive for me, and this debut tour is the culmination of everything I’ve worked toward. For years, people have connected with my voice through movie screens and streaming playlists, but ‘This Is Who We Are’ is about breaking down that digital wall. I’ve waited a long time to look my followers in the eye and share this energy with them and it’s going to be an unforgettable, completely live celebration.”

As per the latest buzz, Abhinav Kumar Upadhyay, Managing Director, Perfect Harmony Productions shared, “Madhubanti Bagchi represents a rare, generational shift in the live music landscape. Over the last 25 years, our mission has always been to elevate pure musical excellence. Her ability to anchor a massive commercial production while maintaining the soul of classical fusion is exactly what live audiences have been craving. This tour isn't just a series of concerts; it’s a high-production celebration of where Indian music is heading.”

In further updates, In a bid to foster true inclusivity and deep community engagement, the tour will eliminate VIP seating, ensuring every attendee enjoys an equal experience, with special student category passes starting at an accessible Rs. 499.
